# BLS fixture excerpt (real public-domain data)

`bls_api_2022_2025_excerpt.json`: the official BLS Public Data API v2 response
(https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/, retrieved 2026-10-15, years 2022-2025) reduced to
series CIU2014300000000I (ECI) and PCU524126524126 (PPI), plus one of the API's
"Series does not exist" messages. Values are unmodified. Used only by offline tests.
